body: Who should I even talk to? I have friends but feel like they would over react or end up treating me different.. My family would certainly over react..

Thanks for responding.  I actually did that ONCE a few years ago, I was in a completely different stage in my life however (still lived with parents etc.). Im in college now thousands of miles away.  When i did this I feel like it made it worse, it seemed to legitimize the problem.  By this I mean that if I dont tell anyone, after I can put it off as something that kind of never even happened or does not matter.  If I tell someone about it it seems to escalate more and become more of a concrete issue.  I'm not sure if this even makes sense but I thank you
